name: Verify adding comment to existing open ticket via assistant
objective: Validate that a user can add information to an existing open ticket through the assistant and it is saved as a customer-visible comment.
precondition: User is logged in, on home page, AI Assistant panel is open. User has an open ticket INC-12345.

steps.description: Click the Agentforce icon on the home page
Request to add information to a specific ticket
steps.testData: "I want to add information to INC-12345"
steps.expectedResult: The assistant acknowledges and prompts for the information

steps.testData: "The issue is now affecting all users on the 3rd floor"

steps.description: Verify the information is saved as a comment
steps.expectedResult: The assistant confirms the comment was added to the ticket

steps.description: Verify the assigned fulfiller receives notification
steps.expectedResult: The assigned fulfiller is notified of the update
